content.text: Directions: You will hear a dialogue about {{3_dialogue_topic}}. It will be read twice. Retell the dialogue with the following given points. You will have sixty seconds to prepare and sixty seconds to retell. 注意信息提取与转述的完整性。(你将听到一段关于{{3_dialogue_topic}}的对话。对话将读 2 遍。根据下面所给提示复述对话内容。你将有 60 秒的准备时间和 60 秒的复述时间。注意信息的完整提取与转述。)

Part Three: Retell. You will hear a dialogue about {{3_dialogue_topic}}. It will be read twice. Retell the dialogue with the following given points. You will have sixty seconds to prepare and sixty seconds to retell.

gradingInfo.gradingInfo:
**评分标准**：

- 核心评分点：
  - 信息提取完整性(information completeness)：包含 who/what/when/where/why/how 关键信息，不遗漏要点 (40%)
  - 转述能力(retelling ability)：用自己的话连贯转述，非逐字背诵原文 (30%)
  - 语言准确性(language accuracy)：语法正确、时态一致、用词恰当 (30%)

- 满分2.5分
- 考查重点：听一段约200词的对话（故事、通知、情景对话），抓取核心信息并用第三人称/过去时态进行连贯转述
- 准备60秒 + 复述60秒
